meta_stationDescription: Wind, gusts and direction for {name} ({code}): 10-day forecast from several weather models, Superforecast and Forecast.
error_internal: Something went wrong on the server.
notice_sourceUnavailable: The weather data could not be fetched just now. Showing the latest data available.
notice_budgetExhausted: Today's limit for weather data is reached. Showing the latest data available.
home_lead: Wind forecast for water sports: what the station measures right now, what the models predict, and which model was closest there recently.
search_hint: An airport (name or ICAO code such as EDSB), a place or coordinates such as 48.78, 8.08.
home_exampleEdsbText: On the Rhine near Iffezheim, METAR station EDSB
home_exampleLgrpText: Diagoras airport, close to the spots on the west coast
title_home: Windfenster: wind forecast for water sports
forecast_note: Fine models hourly, global ones every 3 hours, from day 8 as a trend. Local time, bar height = wind.
forecast_empty: There is no forecast for this place yet.
live_none: No measurement in the last 24 hours.
metar_cavok: visibility 10 km or more, no cloud below 5,000 ft, no weather
metar_NOSIG: no significant change in the next 2 hours
metar_TEMPO: within the next 2 hours at times:
water_history: Water level over the last 7 days, from {from} to {to} cm
water_currentNote: Current estimated from the flow and a blanket cross-section
models_auto: Auto choice: {model} came closest to the measurements here over the last 30 days.
models_autoMix: Auto choice: the mix came closer to the measurements here over the last 30 days than any single model.
models_collecting: The first model of a fixed order is preselected. From 14 days of measurements on, Windfenster picks the model that is closest here ({days} of 14 so far).
models_noStation: The first model of a fixed order is preselected; without a station within 5 km there is no ranking here.
ranking_sub: Mean error against {source}, last 30 days, first day ahead
ranking_empty: Nothing verified yet. As soon as measurements and stored runs come together, Windfenster compares them every hour.
ranking_young: Only {days} of 14 days: the order can still change a lot.
chart_sub: Mean wind in {unit} · dots = {source}, measured so far
chart_aria: Line chart: the models' wind forecast for today, 7 am to 7 pm
error_passkeysOff: Signing in is not set up on this server.
error_passkeyRejected: The passkey was not accepted. Please try again.
error_invalidName: The name must be 1 to 60 characters long.
error_invalidFavorite: The wind directions are not valid.
history_aria: Line chart: mean wind and gusts {day}, with wind direction
map_legend: Colour scale of the wind speed in {unit}
map_legendGusts: Colour scale of the gusts in {unit}
map_noGusts: {model} has no gusts for this hour; the colours show the wind.
map_empty: No wind data for the map yet. The server fetches ICON-D2 and ECMWF every 10 minutes; the first hours arrive a few minutes after it starts.
map_spotHours: The coming hours at this place
map_noMeasurement: No measurement in the last 2 hours
map_measuredCurve: Measured over the last {hours} hours: {min} to {max} {unit}
history_hint: Point or tap for the values at any time
login_lead: Quickest with a passkey: your fingerprint, face or device PIN. Or with e-mail and password.
login_create: Create an account with a passkey
login_createHint: The passkey stays on your device or in your password manager and works only for this site. You can add it on more devices later.
login_unsupported: This browser cannot use passkeys. Try a current browser or another device.
account_passkeysHint: Create a passkey on every device you want to sign in with.
account_addPasskey: Add a passkey on this device
account_deleteHint: The account, its favourites and sign-ins are deleted. You can then remove the passkeys from your devices there.
error_invalidEmail: That does not look like an e-mail address.
error_emailTaken: There is an account with this e-mail address already.
error_weakPassword: The password must be at least 10 characters long.
error_tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait 15 minutes.
login_passwordCreate: Create an account with a password
login_passwordHint: At least 10 characters. You can add a passkey in your account later.
account_passwordNone: So far you sign in with a passkey only. With e-mail and password you get in without a passkey too.
favorite_lead: Give it a name of your own and say which wind directions work here.
gear_low: Too little wind for your gear
gear_lead: Enter for every kite, wing, sail and parawing the wind you ride it in (mean wind in knots). The forecast then shows what fits each hour.
gear_empty: Nothing entered yet. Add a size or start from a template.
gear_templateHint: Rough values for about 80 kg. They replace the entries of this kind in the list above; adjust them and save.
account_gearHint: Your sizes and their wind range, for the forecast and the spot cards. The same on every device.
error_invalidGear: Check the entries: size above 0, "from" below "to", at most 30 pieces.
error_invalidAlarm: Check the alarm: wind between 0 and 80 kn, at least one kind of message and one way (push or e-mail).
error_invalidSubscription: This browser cannot take push messages.
alarm_lead: We'll tell you when the wind is on here.
alarm_gearHint: Counts only hours one of your sizes is in its wind range.
alarm_forecastHint: For today and tomorrow, two hours or more in a row, from your spot's directions, in daylight. If the window changes much or falls through, we tell you.
alarm_live: As soon as the station measures it
alarm_liveHint: Two measurements in a row, once a day.
alarm_emailNone: E-mail: add an address on the account page first
alarm_emailOff: E-mails are not set up on this server.
alarm_night: Between 9 pm and 7 am it stays quiet.
push_on: Push is on on this device.
push_off: Push is off on this device.
push_denied: Your browser blocks notifications for Windfenster. Allow them in the site settings.
push_refused: Without your permission the browser cannot show messages.
push_homeScreen: On an iPhone: open Windfenster in Safari, tap Share → “Add to Home Screen” and start it from there. Then you can turn push on here.
push_unsupported: This browser cannot take push messages. Use e-mail or another browser.
notify_lead: This is where your alarms go. Push is per device: turn it on on every phone that should be told.
notify_testNone: Nothing arrived: turn push on or add an e-mail address.
sources_lead: Windfenster shows open data from many weather services and projects. Here is where each comes from, under which licence, and how the source wants to be credited.
sources_code: Windfenster itself is open source under the AGPL-3.0.
sources_openMeteo: Forecasts of every model on station and place pages, the place search
sources_dwd: ICON-D2 and ICON global on the wind map and in alarms, 10-minute measurements, the list of weather stations, ten years of hourly values for the wind statistics, ICON-D2 through Open-Meteo
sources_ecmwf: ECMWF IFS on the wind map worldwide and through Open-Meteo
sources_awc: Airports' METARs and TAFs, and which airports send them
sources_ourAirports: Names and places of the airports
sources_osm: Basemap: coasts, water, roads, places, land use, buildings (through Protomaps)
sources_mapterhorn: The map's relief, from elevation data of many national surveys
sources_naturalEarth: Basemap where the server has none of its own
sources_protomaps: Map tiles as PMTiles and the map style
stats_pending: Being worked out from ten years of measurements, once, takes about a minute …
stats_windyHint: Bars: share of windy days, with at least two daylight hours of {kn} {unit} or more mean wind.
stats_roseHint: Wind rose: how often how much wind came from each direction, as a share of all hours; calm in the middle.
sources_iem: Ten years of airport METARs for the wind statistics
taf_help: TAF: the aviation forecast, written by meteorologists for the airport, for 24 to 30 hours. A span means at times or while changing.
glance_note: Bars every 3 hours, tick = gust, arrow = main direction by day
glance_dayWorks: Some hours this day work at your spot.
error_emailOff: E-mail is not set up on this server.
error_tooSoon: Sent a moment ago. Please try again in a few minutes.
error_invalidLink: This link is invalid, already used or expired. Ask for a new one on the account page.
notify_emailUnconfirmed: {email} is not confirmed yet. Until then no alarms go out by e-mail.
notify_confirmationSent: Sent. Open the link in the e-mail; it works for 24 hours.
alarm_emailUnconfirmed: E-mail: confirm your address on the account page first
confirm_lead: Confirm that Windfenster may send alarms to this address.
error_tooManyPlaces: Very many new places were opened from your connection. Please try again in an hour; stations and places already open still work.
rows_legend: Bar = wind · line below = wind, then on to the gust · dashed = TAF (aerodrome forecast)
error_signupClosed: New accounts are not open here right now, or only with a valid invitation.
error_lastAdmin: This is the last admin. Make another account an admin first.
error_invalidSetting: This value does not work here.
admin_onlyAdmins: The admin page is for admins only. An account becomes an admin on the server with windfenster admin <e-mail>.
admin_usersLead: {total} accounts · {week} new this week · {month} active in the last 30 days
admin_deleteText: The account and all it holds (spots, alarms, gear, devices) will be gone. This cannot be undone.
admin_passwordNote: Nobody sees passwords, admins neither. An account with neither a passkey nor a password cannot sign in any more.
admin_pickUser: Pick an account on the left.
